rVenue.name: Dash/IMC Financial Markets
rVenue.materialAspects: Velox Clearing, LLC routes listed Options order flow to DASH Financial Securities recognized under MPID: DASH for the order handling and execution of customer market and limit orders. Velox Clearing LLC receives payment on NON-PENNY contracts with the base commission being $0.80 per contract executed. Velox Clearing LLC receives payment on PENNY contracts with the base commission being $0.40 per contract executed. Velox Clearing LLC receives payment on SPY contracts with the base commission being $0.20 per contract executed.
